data.title: Environmental and economic benefits of UHPFRC intervention in bridge management for the Swiss network
data.author: Numa Bertola, Célia Küpfer, Eugen Brühwiler
data.summary: The study evaluates using ultra-high-performance fiber-reinforced cementitious composite (UHPFRC) for bridge maintenance in Switzerland, finding it feasible for 99.7% of bridges, potentially saving 7.7 million tons of CO2 equivalent and 18.5 billion Swiss francs over 80 years compared to traditional methods.
data.title_cn: UHPFRC 干预瑞士网络桥梁管理的环境和经济效益
data.abstract_cn: 该研究评估了瑞士使用超高性能纤维增强水泥基复合材料 (UHPFRC) 进行桥梁维护的情况，发现它对于 99.7% 的桥梁都是可行的，与传统方法相比，在 80 年内可能节省 770 万吨二氧化碳当量和 185 亿瑞士法郎。

data.title: An experimentally-informed polymer model reveals high resolution organization of genomic loci
data.author: Rahul Mittal, Dieter W. Heermann, Arnab Bhattacherjee
data.summary: Abstract Gene expression patterns are governed by the hierarchical organization of the genome. Numerous efforts, leveraging both polymer physics-based models and experimental imaging technologies, have sought to elucidate the structure-function relationship of chromatin fibers. However, a major challenge is posed by the multi-scale nature of chromatin organization. Here, we present an experimentally informed, polymer physics-based model capable of reconstructing chromatin structural ensembles by integrating low-resolution contact data with MNase-derived nucleosome positioning information. We apply our approach to multiple human genomic loci. Our analysis shows distinct structural features associated with active and inactive chromatin states, providing insights into the relationship between genomic organization and transcriptional activity. These findings offer a framework for understanding genome structure-function relationships.
data.title_cn: 基于实验的聚合物模型揭示了基因组位点的高分辨率组织
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 基因表达模式受基因组的层次结构控制。利用基于聚合物物理的模型和实验成像技术，人们进行了大量的努力，试图阐明染色质纤维的结构与功能关系。然而，染色质组织的多尺度性质带来了重大挑战。在这里，我们提出了一种基于实验的、基于聚合物物理的模型，能够通过整合低分辨率接触数据与 MNase 衍生的核小体定位信息来重建染色质结构整体。我们将我们的方法应用于多个人类基因组位点。我们的分析显示了与活性和非活性染色质状态相关的独特结构特征，为基因组组织和转录活性之间的关系提供了见解。这些发现为理解基因组结构与功能关系提供了一个框架。

data.title: Enhancing diagnostic safety with low iodine, low radiation CTPA classification using deep learning
data.author: Mingyao Hong, Tao Gu, Hongyu An, Xu Fan, Xinfeng Zhang
data.summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a life-threatening condition for which computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the standard diagnostic modality. However, conventional CTPA protocols require relatively high iodine contrast and radiation doses, raising concerns about renal injury and radiation exposure. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based framework for PE diagnosis under low-iodine and low-radiation CTPA conditions. The proposed two-stage framework integrates image enhancement and classification by jointly leveraging original low-exposure images and their super-resolved counterparts. We further construct and publicly release a low-iodine, low-radiation CTPA dataset developed in collaboration with a clinical institution to support reproducible research in safe imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method substantially improves diagnostic performance compared with single-branch baselines, achieving an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.928 while maintaining balanced sensitivity and specificity. These findings suggest that the proposed framework enables accurate and safer PE diagnosis under reduced contrast and radiation exposure, offering a practical solution for improving diagnostic safety in clinical CTPA imaging.
data.title_cn: 利用深度学习进行低碘、低辐射 CTPA 分类，增强诊断安全性
data.abstract_cn: 肺栓塞 (PE) 是一种危及生命的疾病，计算机断层扫描肺血管造影 (CTPA) 是标准诊断方式。然而，传统的 CTPA 方案需要相对较高的碘对比和辐射剂量，引起了对肾损伤和辐射暴露的担忧。在这项研究中，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的低碘和低辐射 CTPA 条件下 PE 诊断框架。所提出的两阶段框架通过联合利用原始低曝光图像及其超分辨率对应图像来集成图像增强和分类。我们进一步构建并公开发布与临床机构合作开发的低碘、低辐射 CTPA 数据集，以支持安全成像的可重复研究。实验结果表明，与单分支基线相比，所提出的方法显着提高了诊断性能，实现了 0.928 的 ROC 曲线下面积 (AUC)，同时保持平衡的敏感性和特异性。这些发现表明，所提出的框架能够在降低对比度和辐射暴露的情况下实现准确、更安全的 PE 诊断，为提高临床 CTPA 成像的诊断安全性提供实用的解决方案。

data.title: A real-time industrial safety automation using YOLO architectures leveraging diverse chromatic domains
data.author: Natasha Pati, Atul Sharma, Mahendra Kumar Gourisaria, Junali Jasmine Jena, Amitkumar V. Jha, Bhargav Appasani, Nicu Bizon
data.summary: Object detection is a crucial component of computer vision with extensive industrial applications. It involves identifying and localizing objects within an image or video frame, surpassing simple image classification by providing bounding boxes for detected objects. In this work, authors used a real-time approach for evaluating YOLO object detection models on a welding defect dataset, using a multispectral approach across diverse chromatic domains. Specifically, the performance of YOLOv3, YOLOv5, and YOLOv8 is analyzed using multiple color spaces—RGB, HSV, LAB, and YCbCr. To examine how color representation affects detection outcomes. YOLO’s unified architecture optimizes both speed and accuracy, making it well-suited for real-time industrial safety applications. The results indicate that YOLOv8 demonstrates significant improvements in both accuracy and inference speed over previous versions using RGB color space. A normalized mAP@0.5 of 0.592 was achieved using the RGB color space, highlighting YOLOv8’s effectiveness in challenging detection tasks under varying visual conditions. The model’s lightweight structure and computational efficiency make it an excellent fit for real-time welding defect detection in diverse industrial environments which has been demonstrated using a real-time framework.
data.title_cn: 使用 YOLO 架构利用不同色域的实时工业安全自动化
data.abstract_cn: 物体检测是计算机视觉的重要组成部分，具有广泛的工业应用。它涉及识别和定位图像或视频帧内的对象，通过为检测到的对象提供边界框来超越简单的图像分类。在这项工作中，作者使用实时方法在焊接缺陷数据集上评估 YOLO 对象检测模型，并使用跨不同色域的多光谱方法。具体来说，使用多个颜色空间（RGB、HSV、LAB 和 YCbCr）分析 YOLOv3、YOLOv5 和 YOLOv8 的性能。检查颜色表示如何影响检测结果。 YOLO 的统一架构优化了速度和准确性，使其非常适合实时工业安全应用。结果表明，与之前使用 RGB 颜色空间的版本相比，YOLOv8 在准确性和推理速度方面都有显着提高。使用 RGB 颜色空间实现了 0.592 的归一化 mAP@0.5，凸显了 YOLOv8 在不同视觉条件下挑战性检测任务中的有效性。该模型的轻量级结构和计算效率使其非常适合各种工业环境中的实时焊接缺陷检测，这一点已使用实时框架进行了演示。

data.title: Integrated optical fiber devices
data.author: Wei Jin
data.summary: Integrating functional materials, photonic structures and circuits in an optical fiber platform provides opportunities for a range of novel applications. Recently, Yuan TT et al presents a comprehensive review on the development of in-fiber photonic integrated devices and systems, including historic background, methods of integration, structures and materials, functionalities and performances, as well as applications in sensing, communications, signal manipulation and processing, medical diagnosis and treatment. The review also includes insightful analysis and discussion of future research directions.
data.abstract_cn: 将功能材料、光子结构和电路集成在光纤平台中为一系列新颖的应用提供了机会。最近，Yuan TT等人对光纤内光子集成器件和系统的发展进行了全面的回顾，包括历史背景、集成方法、结构和材料、功能和性能，以及在传感、通信、信号操纵和处理、医疗诊断和治疗方面的应用。该评论还包括对未来研究方向的深刻分析和讨论。

data.title: Ambient-energy-driven space-time-coding metasurface for space-frequency-division multiplexing wireless communications
data.author: Han Wei Tian, Chao Song, Dong Jie Wang, Qian Zhu, Tie Jun Cui, Wei Xiang Jiang
data.summary: Programmable metasurfaces have shown exceptional potentials in wireless communications due to their capability to manipulate electromagnetic (EM) waves dynamically and flexibly. However, the large-scale application and flexible deployment of programmable metasurfaces still face challenges of high communication capacity requirements and stringent energy constraints. Here, we report an ambient-energy-driven space-time-coding metasurface to address these issues. On one hand, the metasurface can achieve efficient space-frequency-division multiplexing manipulations by dynamically controlling multiple frequencies and the spatial propagation directions of reflection EM waves. On the other hand, the shared-aperture ambient solar energy harvesting capability and low power consumption characteristic of the metasurface enable it to be self-powered without relying on any external power supply. To demonstrate these remarkable features, a four-channel wireless communication system prototype is built using the programmable metasurface. Experimental results confirm that four distinct images can be transmitted to four user terminals simultaneously, independently, and in real time with remarkably low energy consumption per bit. Such innovative metasurface provides a simple and effective approach for integrating ambient energy harvesting, multi-dimensional microwave manipulation, and direct information modulation on a single physical platform, which will advance the wireless communications in cost-effectiveness, enhanced capacity, energy efficiency, and environmental friendliness.
data.title_cn: 用于空频复用无线通信的环境能量驱动的空时编码超表面
data.abstract_cn: 可编程超表面由于其动态灵活地操纵电磁（EM）波的能力，在无线通信领域显示出非凡的潜力。然而，可编程超表面的大规模应用和灵活部署仍然面临着高通信容量要求和严格的能量约束的挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种环境能量驱动的时空编码超表面来解决这些问题。一方面，超表面可以通过动态控制反射电磁波的多个频率和空间传播方向来实现高效的空频复用操作。另一方面，超表面的共享孔径环境太阳能收集能力和低功耗特性使其能够自供电，无需依赖任何外部电源。为了展示这些显着的功能，使用可编程超表面构建了四通道无线通信系统原型。实验结果证实，四个不同的图像可以同时、独立、实时地传输到四个用户终端，并且每比特的能耗非常低。这种创新的超表面提供了一种简单有效的方法，可以在单个物理平台上集成环境能量收集、多维微波操纵和直接信息调制，这将在成本效益、增强容量、能源效率和环境友好方面推动无线通信。

data.title: Design of an ultra-broadband achromatic metalens from the near- to short-wave infrared
data.author: Yutong Xu, Tailei Wang, Yangyang Zou, Bin Wu, Yongnan Lu, Jiakun Zhang, Liu Zhang, Hua Liu
data.summary: Metalenses are crucial for miniaturized and highly integrated optical systems, yet their inherent chromatic dispersion restricts broader application. Although recent designs have improved achromatic performance, attaining ultra-broadband achromaticity across the near- and short-wave infrared spectra remains challenging, especially when reconciling processing feasibility with structural stability. In response to this challenge, a semi-embedded unit cell is proposed in this paper, which can effectively alleviate the trade-off between performance and fabrication feasibility. By simulating and analyzing a metalens with an aperture of 62µm and a focal length of 65 µm, we demonstrate that the proposed structure achieves achromatic focusing across the 1000–2400 nm wavelength range, even under oblique illumination with incident angles up to 23° (equivalent to a 46°field of view). Within the operating wavelength band, the focal plane shift of the metalens is limited to a maximum of 4.5%. It exhibits an average absolute focusing efficiency of 42.66%, a full width at half maximum (FWHM) close to the diffraction limit, and an average relative focusing efficiency of 49.65%. Additionally, the proposed metalens exhibits high robustness to variations in material properties and geometric parameters, maintaining stable performance under a refractive index tolerance of ±0.04, an embedded region height tolerance of ±5%, an exposed region height tolerance of ±3.75%, and a side length tolerance of ±4%. The proposed semi-embedded structure offers a novel and reliable approach for developing ultra-broadband metalenses, with strong potential for highly integrated imaging and on-chip photonic applications.
data.title_cn: 近短波红外超宽带消色差超透镜的设计
data.abstract_cn: 超透镜对于小型化和高度集成的光学系统至关重要，但其固有的色散限制了更广泛的应用。尽管最近的设计改进了消色差性能，但在近波和短波红外光谱范围内实现超宽带消色差仍然具有挑战性，特别是在协调加工可行性与结构稳定性时。针对这一挑战，本文提出了一种半嵌入式单元，它可以有效缓解性能和制造可行性之间的权衡。通过模拟和分析孔径为 62μm、焦距为 65μm 的超透镜，我们证明所提出的结构即使在入射角高达 23°（相当于 46° 视场）的倾斜照明下，也能在 1000–2400 nm 波长范围内实现消色差聚焦。在工作波长带内，超透镜的焦平面偏移最大限制为 4.5%。它的平均绝对聚焦效率为42.66%，半峰全宽（FWHM）接近衍射极限，平均相对聚焦效率为49.65%。此外，所提出的超透镜对材料特性和几何参数的变化表现出高鲁棒性，在折射率公差为±0.04、嵌入区域高度公差为±5%、暴露区域高度公差为±3.75%和边长公差为±4%的情况下保持稳定的性能。所提出的半嵌入式结构为开发超宽带超透镜提供了一种新颖且可靠的方法，具有高度集成成像和片上光子应用的巨大潜力。

data.title: 1.9 Tbps receiver optical subassembly based on LAN-WDM hybrid integration
data.author: Song Huang, Yue Wang, Liangliang Wang, Jiashun Zhang, Yuanda Wu, Junming An, Yu Liu
data.summary: A low-cost, hybrid-integrated 1.6-TbE local-area network wavelength-division multiplexing (LAN-WDM) receiver optical subassembly (ROSA) based on an O-band arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) demultiplexer has been developed. Vertical coupling between the AWG and the photodetector (PD) array is achieved by polishing the AWG output facet at an angle of 41°, resulting in a maximum coupling efficiency of 88.4%. A flexible printed circuit (FPC) board with 16 differential high-frequency coplanar waveguides (CPWs) is designed to deliver radio-frequency (RF) signal outputs and to supply power to the transimpedance amplifier (TIA) and PD arrays. All lanes of the ROSA exhibit receiver sensitivities better than −7.3 dBm and support the transmission of a single-channel 60-GBaud four-level pulse-amplitude modulation (PAM-4) signal, enabling an aggregate data rate of 1.9 Tb/s.
data.title_cn: 基于LAN-WDM混合集成的1.9Tbps接收光组件
data.abstract_cn: 开发出了一种基于 O 波段阵列波导光栅 (AWG) 解复用器的低成本、混合集成 1.6-TbE 局域网波分复用 (LAN-WDM) 接收器光学组件 (ROSA)。 AWG 和光电探测器 (PD) 阵列之间的垂直耦合是通过以 41° 角度抛光 AWG 输出面来实现的，最大耦合效率为 88.4%。具有 16 个差分高频共面波导 (CPW) 的柔性印刷电路 (FPC) 板旨在提供射频 (RF) 信号输出并向跨阻放大器 (TIA) 和 PD 阵列供电。 ROSA 的所有通道均表现出优于 −7.3 dBm 的接收器灵敏度，并支持单通道 60 GBaud 四级脉冲幅度调制 (PAM-4) 信号的传输，从而实现 1.9 Tb/s 的聚合数据速率。

data.title: Infrared polarimetric imaging enhancement via multiscale inverse modulation and bio-inspired neural reconstruction
data.author: Hongli Jiang, Zhiguo Fan, Yunyou Hu, Cailing Zhao, Siwei Zhang
data.summary: Infrared polarization image enhancement and reconstruction are crucial for national defense applications such as target recognition, environmental perception, and weak target detection. Single-modality infrared polarization imaging, however, faces key challenges: limited polarization feature extraction, insufficient background suppression, and unstable reconstruction quality. In the 2024 Anhui field experiment, conventional DoLP (Degree of Linear Polarization) models showed high false-detection rates in low-polarization regions. To address this, we propose a maximum response channel difference representation, improving spatial frequency by up to 30%, and a pixel-level inverse modulation with dynamic weighting, achieving up to 370% contrast enhancement under occlusion. An NSST-MSD-PCNN framework further integrates shearlet-based geometric sensitivity with adaptive pulse-coupled neural networks. Validation on the IPEG (Infrared Polarization Evaluation Gallery) benchmark and deployment on the DJI M300 RTK UAV demonstrate superior performance in both subjective and objective metrics, providing an engineering-ready solution for robust infrared polarization imaging in complex environments.
data.title_cn: 通过多尺度逆调制和仿生神经重建增强红外偏振成像
data.abstract_cn: 红外偏振图像增强和重建对于目标识别、环境感知、弱目标检测等国防应用至关重要。然而，单模态红外偏振成像面临着关键挑战：偏振特征提取有限、背景抑制不足、重建质量不稳定。在2024年安徽现场实验中，传统的DoLP（线偏振度）模型在低偏振区域表现出较高的误检率。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了最大响应通道差异表示，将空间频率提高了高达 30%，以及具有动态加权的像素级逆调制，在遮挡下实现了高达 370% 的对比度增强。 NSST-MSD-PCNN 框架进一步将基于剪切波的几何灵敏度与自适应脉冲耦合神经网络相集成。 IPEG（红外偏振评估库）基准的验证以及在 DJI M300 RTK 无人机上的部署在主观和客观指标上均表现出卓越的性能，为复杂环境中稳健的红外偏振成像提供了工程就绪的解决方案。

data.title: 101.47-b/s/Hz spectral efficiency transmission using probabilistic shaping 16-QAM in 7-core 3-mode fiber
data.author: Hao Guo, Darui Xu, Ting Li, Xuemei Du, Wenhua Ren, Zhongwei Tan, Yan Liu, Ting Feng, Qi Qin, Zhenyu Gu, Chenhui Guo, Xinkuo Yu, Meng Xiang, Gai Zhou, Hailin Yang, Jiajing Tu, Jianxin Ren, Huan Chang, Jiancheng Liu, Fengping Yan
data.summary: The exponential growth of global data traffic has caused conventional single-mode fiber systems to approach the Shannon limit, which will require breakthroughs to meet future communication demands. This paper experimentally demonstrates the first 7-core 3-mode optical fiber system based on probabilistic shaping 16-quadrature amplitude modulation (PS-16QAM). The transmitted symbols employed a Maxwell-Boltzmann probability distribution to optimize the constellation point energy allocation, reducing signal peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) compared with conventional 16QAM. The transmission fiber employed a graded-index profile and trench-assisted structure to suppress inter-core crosstalk. The system integrated wavelength division multiplexing (WDM), polarization division multiplexing (PDM), and space division multiplexing (SDM). This achieved parallel transmission for 126 channels (7 cores × 3 modes × 3 wavelengths × 2 polarizations) over an 80.6-km positive-negative differential group delay (DGD) compensated link. A data-assisted joint frequency offset estimation and synchronization algorithm and a multiple-input multiple-output least mean squares (MIMO-LMS) equalization algorithm integrated with maximum likelihood phase recovery ensured reliable signal recovery. Under a 25.5% soft-decision forward error correction (FEC) threshold, the system achieved a maximum spectral efficiency of 101.47 b/s/Hz. Experiments validated the feasibility of probabilistic shaping techniques in multi-core few-mode fiber systems, providing crucial technical support for next-generation ultra-high-capacity optical communication systems.
data.title_cn: 在 7 芯 3 模光纤中使用概率整形 16-QAM 实现 101.47-b/s/Hz 频谱效率传输
data.abstract_cn: 全球数据流量的指数级增长已导致传统单模光纤系统接近香农极限，这需要突破才能满足未来的通信需求。本文通过实验演示了第一个基于概率整形16正交幅度调制（PS-16QAM）的7芯3模光纤系统。传输符号采用麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼概率分布来优化星座点能量分配，与传统的 16QAM 相比，降低了信号峰均功率比 (PAPR)。传输光纤采用渐变折射率分布和沟槽辅助结构来抑制芯间串扰。该系统集成了波分复用（WDM）、偏振复用（PDM）和空分复用（SDM）。实现了80.6公里正负差分群时延（DGD）补偿链路上126通道（7芯×3模式×3波长×2偏振）的并行传输。数据辅助的联合频偏估计和同步算法以及与最大似然相位恢复集成的多输入多输出最小均方（MIMO-LMS）均衡算法确保了可靠的信号恢复。在 25.5% 软判决前向纠错 (FEC) 阈值下，系统实现了 101.47 b/s/Hz 的最大频谱效率。实验验证了概率整形技术在多芯少模光纤系统中的可行性，为下一代超高容量光通信系统提供了关键的技术支撑。

data.title: Nature of the 3.28 eV photoluminescence peak in unintentionally doped GaN microdisk grown by Na flux method
data.author: Zhiwei Si, Tao Zhang, Xiaohui Peng, Shunan Zheng, Jianfeng Wang, Zongliang Liu, Ke Xu
data.summary: This Ultraviolet luminescence (UVL) peak near 3.28 eV, as a common defect-induced luminescence phenomenon, has been a subject of extensive study as its origin is linked to the impurity incorporation during growth, which is crucial for material quality control in GaN-based optoelectronic and microelectronic devices. However, the UVL-related transition mechanism is controversial. GaN microdisks grown by Na-flux method with c-plane and (101¯1)-plane, can provide what we believe is a new perspective to reveal UVL-related mechanism. The low-temperature photoluminescence (PL) demonstrates the stronger UVL on the c-plane compared to the (101¯1)-plane. With increasing power and temperature, there is a significant blue shift of UVL in the c-plane. Therefore, the UVL-related mechanism may be the DAP transition. In unintentionally doped GaN, we suggest that the shallow acceptor associated with this DAP defect may be Mg-related defect. SIMS results show that c-plane has a high concentration of Mg impurities, which is consistent with the PL results that the c-plane has a significant UVL peak intensity. It is also consistent with the conclusion that the UVL-related shallow acceptor is Mg Ga . This work reveals the origin of ultraviolet luminescence in Na-flux GaN, providing new insights into the optical properties of GaN crystals grown by the Na-flux method.
data.title_cn: Na通量法生长的无意掺杂GaN微盘中3.28 eV光致发光峰的性质
data.abstract_cn: 这种接近 3.28 eV 的紫外发光 (UVL) 峰是一种常见的缺陷诱导发光现象，一直是广泛研究的主题，因为其起源与生长过程中的杂质掺入有关，这对于 GaN 基光电和微电子器件中的材料质量控制至关重要。然而，UVL相关的转变机制存在争议。通过Na-flux法生长的具有c面和(101´1)面的GaN微盘，可以为揭示UVL相关机制提供新的视角。低温光致发光 (PL) 表明 c 面上的 UVL 比 (101−1) 面上的 UVL 更强。随着功率和温度的增加，c 平面中的 UVL 发生显着的蓝移。因此，UVL相关机制可能是DAP转变。在无意掺杂的 GaN 中，我们认为与该 DAP 缺陷相关的浅受主可能是与 Mg 相关的缺陷。 SIMS结果表明c面具有高浓度的Mg杂质，这与c面具有显着的UVL峰强度的PL结果一致。这也与UVL相关的浅受主是Mg Ga的结论一致。这项工作揭示了Na-flux GaN中紫外发光的起源，为通过Na-flux法生长的GaN晶体的光学特性提供了新的见解。

data.title: Eigenvalue-accelerated LDOS optimization of high-𝑄 optical resonances
data.author: George Shaker, Beñat Martinez de Aguirre Jokisch, Pengning Chao, Steven Johnson
data.summary: We demonstrate a new method that yields orders-of-magnitude acceleration in inverse design (e.g. topology optimization) of high-$Q$ resonant cavities to maximize the local density of states (LDOS), and which is also applicable to other resonant-response metrics. The key idea is that, once conventional LDOS optimization has identified a strong resonance, subsequent optimizations can exploit a fast shift-invert eigensolver to ensure that the LDOS remains centered at the resonance peak. We show that this eliminates ill-conditioning at sharp resonances that otherwise dramatically slows LDOS (and similar) optimization for $Q \gg 100$. Our method is demonstrated by design of $Q>10^6$ resonant cavities in 1d and 2d dielectric systems.
data.title_cn: 高𝑄光学共振的特征值加速 LDOS 优化
data.abstract_cn: 我们展示了一种新方法，可以在高 Q$ 谐振腔的逆向设计（例如拓扑优化）中产生数量级的加速，以最大化局部态密度（LDOS），并且该方法也适用于其他谐振响应指标。关键思想是，一旦传统的 LDOS 优化识别出强共振，后续优化就可以利用快速移位反转本征解算器来确保 LDOS 保持以共振峰值为中心。我们证明，这消除了尖锐共振下的病态调节，否则会显着减慢 $Q \gg 100$ 的 LDOS（和类似）优化速度。我们的方法通过一维和二维介电系统中 $Q>10^6$ 谐振腔的设计来证明。

data.title: Suppressing mode partition noise in multimode VCSELs via lateral geometry control
data.author: Ting-Yu Wu, Yun-Cheng Yang, Taixian Zhang, Camel Shih, Chao-Hsin Wu
data.summary: This study presents a geometry-driven approach to suppress mode partition noise (MPN) in multimode vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (VCSELs) for high-speed short-reach links. Three VCSELs with distinct lateral geometries were investigated, all exhibiting similar static and small-signal performance. The aperture geometry primarily determines the transverse modal distribution, where competition among different mode groups serves as the principal mechanism driving MPN. Among the designs, the intentionally engineered asymmetric aperture concentrates modal energy into a dominant mode group, yielding a root-mean-square (RMS) spectral width of 0.387 nm and the lowest low-frequency relative intensity noise (RIN). The device achieves a transmitter dispersion eye closure quaternary (TDECQ) of 0.86 dB in the back-to-back case and 1.24 dB after 100 m OM4 fiber transmission, with corresponding timing jitter of 6.65 ps and 8.03 ps. The results confirm that lateral-geometry optimization effectively suppresses MPN without degrading intrinsic performance, enabling higher-margin optical interconnects.
data.title_cn: 通过横向几何控制抑制多模 VCSEL 中的模式分配噪声
data.abstract_cn: 这项研究提出了一种几何驱动的方法来抑制高速短距离链路多模垂直腔表面发射激光器 (VCSEL) 中的模式分配噪声 (MPN)。研究了三种具有不同横向几何形状的 VCSEL，它们都表现出相似的静态和小信号性能。孔径几何形状主要决定横向模态分布，其中不同模态组之间的竞争是驱动 MPN 的主要机制。在这些设计中，特意设计的不对称孔径将模态能量集中到主模组中，产生 0.387 nm 的均方根 (RMS) 谱宽和最低的低频相对强度噪声 (RIN)。该器件在背靠背情况下实现了 0.86 dB 的发射机色散眼图闭合四进制 (TDECQ)，在 100 m OM4 光纤传输后实现了 1.24 dB，相应的定时抖动为 6.65 ps 和 8.03 ps。结果证实，横向几何优化可有效抑制 MPN，而不会降低内在性能，从而实现更高利润的光学互连。

data.title: Induced fit growth of Ga-based semiconductor thin films for brain-inspired electronics and optoelectronics
data.author: Zixu Sa, Kepeng Song, You Meng, Wenfeng Wu, Zhaocong Wang, Pengsheng Li, Jie Zhang, Zeqi Zang, Guangcan Wang, Mingxu Wang, Zhitai Jia, Yang Tan, Weifeng Li, SenPo Yip, Feng Chen, Johnny C. Ho, Zai-xing Yang
data.summary: Abstract Current crystalline thin-film production techniques typically require specific growth substrates, posing significant challenges for their use in flexible electronics and integrated optoelectronics. In response to these challenges, we introduce a novel method called ‘induced fit growth’, inspired by the induced fit theory in molecular biology. This method overcomes the limitations of current techniques by enabling the deposition of Ga-based semiconductor films, including GaSb, GaSe, GaAs, and GaAsSb, with controllable thickness and morphology on arbitrary substrates. Utilizing a low-cost, wafer-scale vapor deposition process compatible with standard semiconductor procedures, these Ga-based films can be patterned for various functional applications. For example, the patterned Ga-based thin films exhibit broad applicability in p-channel transistor arrays (with hole mobility of 0.25 cm 2 V⁻ 1 s⁻ 1 ), functional synaptic devices, and flexible omnidirectional imaging sensors (maintaining functionality at incident angles as low as 5°). Overall, the proposed induced fit growth method facilitates the growth of Ga-based semiconductor films with greater integration flexibility, enhancing their advanced functionality and broad applicability.
data.title_cn: 用于类脑电子学和光电子学的镓基半导体薄膜的诱导配合生长
data.abstract_cn: 摘要 当前的晶体薄膜生产技术通常需要特定的生长基板，这对其在柔性电子和集成光电子中的使用提出了重大挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了一种称为“诱导拟合生长”的新方法，其灵感来自于分子生物学中的诱导拟合理论。该方法克服了当前技术的局限性，能够在任意基底上沉积厚度和形貌可控的 Ga 基半导体薄膜，包括 GaSb、GaSe、GaAs 和 GaAsSb。利用与标准半导体工艺兼容的低成本晶圆级气相沉积工艺，这些 Ga 基薄膜可以针对各种功能应用进行图案化。例如，图案化的Ga基薄膜在p沟道晶体管阵列（空穴迁移率为0.25 cm 2 V-1 s-1）、功能性突触器件和灵活的全向成像传感器（在低至5°的入射角下保持功能）中表现出广泛的适用性。总体而言，所提出的诱导配合生长方法有利于Ga基半导体薄膜的生长，具有更大的集成灵活性，增强了其先进的功能和广泛的适用性。
